_comment: Curated model catalog for the Personal AI Companion (Phase 1 Step 1.6). Bundled in the app, never fetched from the network. size_bytes is the approximate on-disk Ollama size; min_ram_gb is the minimum system RAM for usable CPU inference. Loaded by src/models/catalog.py.

models.name: llama3.1:8b
models.description: Meta's balanced 8B model. The best default for most machines — strong reasoning, good instruction-following, reasonable speed on CPU.

models.name: llama3.2:latest
models.description: A lightweight 3B model. Noticeably faster on modest hardware, at some cost to answer depth. A good choice on 8 GB machines.

models.name: phi4-mini:latest
models.description: Microsoft's compact 3.8B model tuned for reasoning and instruction-following. Fast, with quality above its weight class.

models.name: mistral:latest
models.description: Mistral AI's 7B model. A capable general-purpose alternative to Llama 3.1 with a slightly smaller footprint.

models.name: qwen2.5:7b
models.description: Alibaba's 7B model with strong multilingual and structured-output performance. A solid pick if your notes mix languages.

models.name: gemma2:9b
models.description: Google's 9B model. Higher answer quality than the 7–8B options, but slower on CPU and needs more memory headroom.
